title: Ring of Beguiling

sources.title: Charmed
markers: removed if the creature is attacked

summary: Unobtainable ring that casts Charm Person once per Long Rest.

fields.Charm Person: Level 1, Action, one humanoid within 60 ft. Wisdom save against spell save DC prevents Charmed for 10 turns. Target cannot attack you and you gain advantage on Charisma checks in dialogue. Your harmful attack on the target can end the effect.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
